operations.name: List File Systems
operations.notes: Lists active filesystems on HNS-enabled accounts with prefix filtering and opaque local continuation tokens.

operations.name: Create File System
operations.notes: Creates the same container visible to Blob. Filesystem metadata and encryption options are unavailable.

operations.name: Get File System Properties
operations.notes: Returns the shared ETag, Last-Modified, and HNS flag. No filesystem metadata or encryption properties.

operations.name: Delete File System
operations.notes: Deletes the shared container immediately. No retention, recreation delay, or conditional delete.

operations.name: List Paths
operations.notes: Lists files and directories recursively or one level at a time, optionally scoped to a directory. Uses local continuation tokens and binary name order; no beginFrom or ownership fields.

operations.name: Create Path
operations.notes: Creates directories with implicit parent directories and ETag conditions. File creation, rename, and ACL options are not implemented here.

operations.name: Read File
operations.notes: Reads the same committed Blob bytes, with ETag conditions, existing Blob lease checks, and single byte ranges. No range checksums or date conditions.

operations.name: Get Path Properties
operations.notes: Returns the resource type and ETag for files and directories, plus file content properties and metadata. Owner, ACL, and lease properties are unavailable.

operations.name: Delete Path
operations.notes: Deletes files and empty directories with ETag conditions and enforces existing Blob file leases. Recursive and paginated delete are unavailable.
